title: Certified Blockchain Developer | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: Certified Blockchain Developer. Category: Blockchain. Duration: 6 months. Description: Blockchain Developer Track, focused on Solidity. This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city.
